verdict.rationale: Vanta documents a first-party Access Reviews solution with pre-built content and workflows that automate the access review process, and it connects to identity providers and other tools. The evidence does not specifically show the recurring cadence, in-app reviewer sign-off, or the review artifact landing in the evidence library. Missing for 10: documented periodic/recurring review scheduling, coverage across connected apps for reviews, in-app reviewer sign-off flow, automatic filing of the completed review into the evidence library, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a security engineer, periodic user access reviews run across connected apps in the platform — reviewers sign off in-app and the artifact lands in the evidence library

citations.quote: The Access Reviews solution includes pre-built content and intuitive workflows to guide organizations - even those new to access reviews - through the process efficiently.
Vanta's Access Reviews solution automates and accelerates the access review process.
Vanta reduces the time spent on and cost of typical reviews by up to 90%.
Connect Vanta with your cloud infrastructure, version control, productivity tools, identity provider, and much more to give you a complete and automated view of your security and compliance.
